purpose: Stop technically correct but commercially thin products before substantial build work.

originEvidence.event: Practice Ladder passed technical checks but the sponsor rejected its buyer value and quality.

requiredChecks.label: One-sentence paid transformation
requiredChecks.passWhen: One sentence names the exact buyer, before-state, useful after-state, and why payment is rational.

requiredChecks.label: Real-current-product depth benchmark
requiredChecks.passWhen: At least three current real products are inspected and the proposed sample meets or deliberately exceeds the relevant depth dimensions.

requiredChecks.label: Finished representative buyer-facing sample
requiredChecks.passWhen: One finished page or screen is shown at intended release quality and demonstrates the core paid value rather than a placeholder.

requiredChecks.label: Adversarial buyer value verdict
requiredChecks.passWhen: A skeptical intended-buyer review identifies a concrete teaching, time-saving, or outcome-improving effect and finds the sample worth paying for at the tested price hypothesis.

requiredChecks.label: Sponsor review of the representative sample
requiredChecks.passWhen: The sponsor reviews the exact sample hash and records PASS before substantial build.

requiredChecks.label: Thin-wrapper and randomizer refusal
requiredChecks.passWhen: The product performs a coherent buyer job that materially exceeds relabeling, prompt wrapping, aggregation without judgment, or random output.

decisionRules.reason: A thin wrapper or randomizer is not a paid transformation.

decisionRules.when: any required evidence is absent, stale, placeholder, or unverified
decisionRules.reason: Technical completeness cannot substitute for commercial-value evidence.

decisionRules.when: adversarial buyer verdict is negative or sponsor verdict is REVISE
decisionRules.reason: Repair the sample or offer before substantial build.

decisionRules.when: all required checks pass and sponsor verdict is PASS for the exact sample hash
decisionRules.reason: Commercial value is provisionally credible enough to request a separate Assembly gate.
